item.title: BAYERO UNIVERSITY, KANO, EMERGES WINNER OF AL-HIKMAH UNIVERSITY INTER-UNIVERSITY QUR’ĀN MEMORIZATION COMPETITION
item.description: Bayero University, Kano, has emerged the overall winner of the Al-Hikmah University Inter-University Qur’ān Memorization Competition. Sadik Ahmad Usman, an engineering student of Bayero University, Kano, emerged as the overall winner of Category B (30 Hizb: Baqarah to Kahf) at the just-concluded 4th Inter-University Qur’ān Memorization Competition, hosted by Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin.
